_doc: EVO lever registry (Owner y 2026-11-12, EVO-PLAN.md). One entry per method lever. family = mechanism family (a research transition must change it). kind = exploit | research | repair (repair levers only repair an instrument). requires = product-relative files that must exist. status open|retired; retired levers name the negative row and its reopen condition. The autopilot adds history-based retirements in state.json, never here.

KSR.what: fwidth operator on frozen held-out CNM cohorts, then certification through the unchanged certify.decide (S28K certified 15; S30K 16 exact all refused TARGET_UNPROVEN).

The 16 S30K held-out exacts were refused TARGET_UNPROVEN (ids absent from the ksr-v5r-s25stage target oracle) and A2_POPULATION_EMPTY (partner pool built from the wrong set; S32K H-A2 SUPPORTED, control 15/15). Extend target-oracle coverage for exactly these ids from ORIGINAL DOL bytes with an independent reader (the S26C C1 method: own DOL and ELF readers, positive and shift negative controls), build the A2 partner pool from the main-capsule hash and size, then certify through the UNCHANGED certify.decide of profile ksr-v5r-s25stage into a separate receipts file. If that profile cannot read the extended oracle unchanged, stop and report INSTRUMENT_FAIL: a profile change is an Owner act. Rival hypotheses: (a) the 16 certify once covered; (b) they fail the oracle or a control (a target mismatch the refusal was hiding).

45 BINARY_EXACT from the fixed S26C '?' fallback (t1 8057ec26): exclude ids certified in any receipts file, then certify through the unchanged certify.decide of profile ksr-v5r-s25stage with the S26D controls (pre/post, A2 negatives from a pool that contains the claims, historical receipts byte-identical) into a separate receipts file. Rival hypotheses: (a) most certify; (b) the fallback source changes bytes of partners (A2 violations).

Owner 2026-11-13 ('y, presupuesto 300M', lane envelope 300M): operator coverage for the 3,653 NO_OPERATOR_FOR_CLASS ids of the S36K sweep. New route code in a new generation (existing route tools stay frozen); a frozen pilot committed before the draw; an independent oracle on the original DOL; a gate with planted mutants; certification only through the unchanged certify.decide. Its certificates land in an additive profile proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Its receipts file gets a receipt_registry.json entry. Rival hypotheses: (a) a bounded operator set makes a measurable share of the 3,653 compile to BINARY_EXACT; (b) the class gaps are type/context gaps an operator cannot close (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

A second independent TU-boundary signal from sbss/bss reference ownership (S32K UKDL candidate c), pre-registered with a positive control on real TU boundaries (not consecutive objects), before any arm field is read. Diagnostic only; no certificate.

Repair the S32K TU-boundary calibration: the control set must be real TU boundaries (S32K recall 0.613 on consecutive-object pairs; AMD-1 n=0 because carved single-fn objects sit between auto_03 pairs). Build the calibration set from boundaries that are independently known, demonstrate its size at freeze, keep the 0.80 bar.

The broad compiler swap matched 0.38 pct of CNM (negative row; reopen if a fingerprint-chosen subset predicts >= 5 pct). S26F W3 found a size<=32 selector with 7.4x held-out enrichment: pre-register that subset prediction on a fresh frozen cohort. Diagnostic only, no certificate: a profile change is an Owner act.

KSR.reopen: a type source that beats the shuffled-type control by >= 5pp with 0 certified regressions

Owner 2026-11-14: a whole-program KSR type model, not a per-function repair: callee prototypes by majority over EVERY call site of the program, struct layouts unioned per global symbol across all functions, iterated to a fixpoint, emitted as per-function source declarations only (no canonical ctx/header write). Known evidence against: on Tennis P1, P1c, P1d and P1e (call-graph propagation) were REFUTED and type repair gave compile without match; so the pre-registered outcome is BINARY_EXACT, never compile. New route code in a new generation (existing route tools stay frozen); a frozen pilot committed before the draw; an independent oracle on the original DOL; a gate with planted mutants; certification only through the unchanged certify.decide. Its receipts file gets a receipt_registry.json entry. Rival hypotheses: (a) whole-program consistency makes a measurable share of NO_COMPILE ids BINARY_EXACT; (b) it moves them to COMPILES_NO_EXACT only (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

Owner 2026-11-14 ('y', session 423c9c50): a third TU-boundary SIGNAL, independent of floatdup and sbss: (1) mwcc allocates statics in reverse declaration order, so a reversal of .bss/.sbss address order against function order marks a unit change; (2) mwcc pools equal string literals within a unit, so an equal string present twice marks two units. Primary source, verbatim: PrimeDecomp/mwcc-tools gc2/docs/matching-guide.md L193 and L213 (PP research/drx-out/PRIMARY-VERIFY-Q7-Q12.md, commit 3ec9bd8f). First prove both rules hold under KSR's compiler with planted two-TU and one-TU fixtures (positive and negative controls). It is a signal under test, NEVER a known-boundary source: calibrating with it would be circular (same pooling mechanism as floatdup). Validate it alone on the frozen known set (the S45K 4-family adequacy rule unchanged), before combining with floatdup/sbss. Diagnostic only, no certificate. Rival hypotheses: (a) the signal recalls >= 0.80 of known boundaries at the frozen precision bar; (b) KSR's linker/compiler breaks either rule (fixture control fails) or recall < 0.80.

Owner 2026-11-14 'y' (session 423c9c50, S49K OWNER QUESTION CERTIFICATION_RULE): AUTHORISED a NEW ADDITIVE profile ksr-v5r-s25stage-s49fm that runs the lane with -fp_contract on for the FMADD class only, under ALL S26C conditions. Control redefined: negative pole = the 40+ certified non-float exact functions must stay byte-identical (any move = profile rejected); positive = every dev exact re-verified by the independent oracle on ORIGINAL DOL bytes (not by certified fma fixtures, which cannot exist). Existing profiles and certificates untouched. Criteria and the dev/held-out split stay as frozen in S49K; held-out 50 is opened once, only after the profile and controls are frozen and committed. No re-cut of the held-out after seeing results; INSTRUMENT_FAIL stays a valid outcome. Rival hypotheses: (a) the profile yields >= 1 held-out BINARY_EXACT FMADD-class function with all 40+ negative controls unmoved; (b) zero held-out exacts, or any control moves (profile rejected).

TENNIS.what: Owner 2026-11-13 ('y', TENNIS envelope 50M): transfer of the KSR q_fallback route (S26C '?' fallback fix, t1 8057ec26; 31 KSR certificates in S35K) to Tennis. Import the frozen route tool read-only from /home/kobii/missions/t1-campaign at a pinned commit (never edit it) and run it over the uncertified Tennis main functions (Tennis 1,198 / 1,797 certified). Certification only through the unchanged certify.decide under an existing Tennis profile. An additive profile, if one is needed, is proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Rival hypotheses: (a) the fallback converts Tennis question-mark-type compile failures as it did on KSR; (b) the Tennis failures are of another class (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

Owner 2026-11-13 ('y', TENNIS envelope 50M): transfer of the KSR S37K operator route to Tennis (s37-callee: 16/40 held-out then 40/117 on KSR CALL_CRCLR; save-area operators were 0/260 and are not transferred). Import the frozen operators and driver read-only from /home/kobii/missions/t1-campaign at a pinned commit (never edit them), census the Tennis COMPILES_NO_MATCH by class, pilot on a frozen held-out draw. Certification only through the unchanged certify.decide under an existing Tennis profile. An additive profile, if one is needed, is proposed in ONE phase line that states: an independent target oracle on the original DOL bytes; a frozen pilot committed before the draw; pre/post controls; A2 negatives; historical receipts byte-identical; separate counters. Rival hypotheses: (a) the call-shape operator converts a measurable share of the Tennis call-shape class as on KSR; (b) the Tennis gaps are type/context gaps (pilot BINARY_EXACT stays 0).

FIFA.what: Identify the CodeWarrior version and flags that built fifaf.code.rso (Wii-era prologues: 15,451 stwu-first, 6,458 _savegpr_ calls, 0 stmw; F0). Run the Wii mwcceppc versions over a frozen control set of small functions whose source is fixed by their bytes and names (tools/ea_formats/rso.py, half-word relocation rule) (getters, trivial constructors and destructors, and functions that call _savegpr_*), comparing each compiled function with the target bytes with relocated words masked. Freeze the control set and the comparison tool in a commit before any run. Deliverable: the version and flags that byte-match, a gate that re-runs the match, and planted mutants (a wrong version, a wrong flag, a shifted target) that turn it red. Rival hypotheses: (a) one version and flag set matches every control; (b) the code mixes toolchains (libraries built apart from the game), shown by controls that match only under different versions. orig/ is read-only. Tools are read-only: /home/kobii/wsr-decomp/build/compilers (run through build/tools/wibo), build/tools/dtk, build/tools/objdiff-cli; nothing is written in /home/kobii/wsr-decomp.

Build a per-function target extractor and byte oracle for the split RSO module (tools/ea_formats/rso.py; dtk 1.8.3 cannot read it): for each of the 24,482 named functions, its bytes from orig/ with every relocated word or half-word masked, and a comparison of a compiled object's function against it. Positive controls (each target against itself) and negative controls (a 4-byte shift, one flipped byte) that must not match, plus a census of how many functions extract cleanly. Freeze the extractor before measuring. This generation builds the instrument and certifies nothing. orig/ is read-only. Tools are read-only: /home/kobii/wsr-decomp/build/compilers (run through build/tools/wibo), build/tools/dtk, build/tools/objdiff-cli; nothing is written in /home/kobii/wsr-decomp.

SDK, NW4R, MSL and TRK functions are identified by their bytes against code already matched elsewhere, never by name alone. orig/ is read-only. MKW.what: Write C/C++ source in the existing decomp layout that matches unmatched main.dol functions of the objdiff categories game, egg and nw4r (1,831 game functions, 706 matched at base 78572c9), smallest functions first. Before any edit, freeze in a commit the target list (function, object, size) and the baseline objdiff report (build/RMCP01/report.json). A function counts only when objdiff reports it 100% matched and ninja still ends with build/RMCP01/main.dol: OK and build/RMCP01/StaticR/StaticR.rel: OK from config/RMCP01/build.sha1. Deliverable: the count moved from unmatched to matched against the frozen list, the report diff, and a gate that rebuilds, checks build.sha1 and re-reads the report, with planted mutants (one changed instruction in a newly matched function, one function marked matched that is not) that turn it red. Rival hypotheses: (a) the small functions match with the object's existing compiler and flags; (b) some objects need a different compiler version or flag set than configure.py assigns, shown by functions that match only after that change. orig/ is read-only; upstream history is never rewritten.

Write C/C++ source in the existing decomp layout that matches unmatched StaticR.rel functions (17,232 functions in 547 objects, 687 matched at base 78572c9), starting with the objects that are closest to complete and, inside them, the smallest functions. Before any edit, freeze in a commit the target list (function, object, size) and the baseline objdiff report (build/RMCP01/report.json). A function counts only when objdiff reports it 100% matched and ninja still ends with build/RMCP01/main.dol: OK and build/RMCP01/StaticR/StaticR.rel: OK from config/RMCP01/build.sha1. Deliverable: the count moved from unmatched to matched against the frozen list, the report diff, and a gate that rebuilds, checks build.sha1 and re-reads the report, with planted mutants (one changed instruction in a newly matched function, one function marked matched that is not) that turn it red. Rival hypotheses: (a) the module code matches with the compiler and flags configure.py assigns to StaticR objects; (b) module objects need per-object flag changes, shown by functions that match only after that change. orig/ is read-only; upstream history is never rewritten.
